title: The Secret Defenses of Your Body | Immunity Explained
description:
Every day your body fights off millions of bacteria, viruses, and parasites — but how? In this episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we reveal the hidden immunity soldiers that protect you without you even noticing. From skin and mucus to tears, stomach acid, and earwax, your body is equipped with an incredible first line of defense called innate immunity.

You’ll learn:

Why your skin is a waterproof fortress that sheds microbes with dead cells.
How nasal mucus and cilia trap and kick out bacteria at 1000 beats per minute.
How stomach acid (pH 2) destroys pathogens before they harm you.
Why tears aren’t just salty water but contain lysozyme, lactoferrin, and lipocalin — natural antibacterial weapons.
The surprising role of earwax as a conveyor belt that traps and expels germs.
Why using cotton buds can do more harm than good.

If you’ve searched for immunity explained, innate immunity, how body fights infections, immune system secrets, skin as defense, stomach acid immunity, tears lysozyme, earwax immune system, this video gives you the scientific perspective.

👉 Don’t underestimate your body’s everyday defenses. And don’t forget to like, comment, share, and subscribe for more myth-busting science videos!

#ImmunityExplained #ScienceOfHealth #InnateImmunity #MythBusting
